If a situation ever does involve threats, monitoring, isolation, or fear for your safety, the general guidance still applies: A phrase-matching tool cannot decide safety. If this involves threats, monitoring, isolation, sex, money, housing, immigration, self-harm pressure, retaliation, or fear for safety, prioritize real-world support from a trusted person, local support service, legal/workplace resource, or emergency help if immediate danger exists.
misuse_warning: One example is a signal to examine, not proof of motive, diagnosis, abuse, danger, or character. Do not use this label to attack, shame, threaten, expose, or retaliate against someone.

related_tactics.name: Guilt-Tripping
related_tactics.definition: Inducing guilt to make refusal feel morally wrong.

related_tactics.name: Emotional Blackmail
related_tactics.definition: Making love or the relationship conditional on compliance.

related_tactics.name: Self-Harm Threats as Leverage
related_tactics.definition: Threatening self-harm to prevent the other person's exit or refusal.

related_tactics.name: Pity Plays
related_tactics.definition: Performing helplessness or victimhood to redirect sympathy.

related_tactics.name: Martyrdom Display
related_tactics.definition: Advertising one's sacrifices to generate obligation.

related_tactics.name: Duty Scripts
related_tactics.definition: Invoking role obligations ('a good son would…') to compel behavior.
